claim: Naismith: distance/5km/h+ascent/600m/h. Tobler speed=6 exp(−3.5·abs(slope+0.05)), slope≈(ascent−descent)/(distance×1000).
assumptions: Tobler requires local slopes along the route; using net slope is a rough proxy and can badly underestimate rolling terrain, breaks and hazards.
Calculation runs entirely on user device after the tool route bundle is loaded.
